caption: Spanish Steps, Rome
composition: Baroque staircase to Trinità dei Monti at clear dawn · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands at the foot of the Spanish Steps at dawn, looking up the long sweep of travertine stairs. The butterfly plan of the steps fans out across the center of the frame, with ochre palazzi closing the left side and a tall ivy-draped facade at the right. At the top, the twin towers of Trinita dei Monti rise against the soft pink and gold of the modelled 23 September 2026, 07:06 sky, the first sunlight warming the church's pale stone.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Spanish Steps in Rome under clear dawn light
